page.overview:
Who is Sasha?

Sasha is an Animal Crossing figure introduced in 2025.

Sasha is a laid-back, often lazy rabbit and one of many Villagers who can settle in your town. He has a particular fondness for cute things, as well as a love of taking selfies.

He is the only male Villager to have Fashion as his hobby.
